name: Momentum
description:
Whenever you or an adjacent ally inflict Injury on a creature, you gain 1 Hope. Whenever you or an adjacent ally knock a creature unconscious, you gain 2 Hope.

At any time, you may convert any amount of Hope, one-for-one, into MP.

Whenever you finish a rest, if your current Hope is greater than your base Hope, it is reduced to equal your base Hope.

Describe how success in battle lifts your heart.
